ablation: Four-arm ablation on the reference workload, 8 capacities.
decay-current: Decay sweep, incumbent constants alpha=60 beta=12 knee=60.
decay-slow: Decay sweep, alpha=600 beta=180 knee=300 (selected on exploratory seeds).
exploratory2: Eight workload families x two capacity fractions, exploratory seed, four arms.
heldout: Eight workload families x two capacity fractions x three held-out seeds, four arms.
heldout-slow: Tuned decay constants (600/180/300) re-checked on held-out seeds.
overhead-capacity-delta: Decision cost of the delta-priced search over the same 12-capacity sweep. Decisions are identical to overhead-capacity-full; only the measured CPU cost differs.
overhead-capacity-full: Decision cost of the full re-sum search over the 12-capacity sweep, seed 20260101. Same matrix as the capacity sweep in 'repro'; produced in the same session as overhead-capacity-delta so the two are comparable.
overhead-families-delta: Decision cost of the delta-priced search on the same family matrix. Decisions are identical to overhead-families-full.
overhead-families-full: Decision cost of the full re-sum search across all eight workload families at 0.85 and 0.95 of each family's working set, seed 20260301.
overhead-p2: Quiet-host overhead ladder, pass 2 (determinism + variance check).
repro: Reference reproduction of the corrected CI replay, 12 capacities.
